# Session Handoff

Use this when context is almost full and work will continue later.

```text
Prepare JTetris handoff in strict mode.
1) Run mvn clean test.
2) Update active spec checklist and Verification.
3) Append one concise entry to doc/specs/context-pack.md.
4) Fill doc/specs/_session-handoff-template.md for the current task.
5) Output a resume prompt with exact file allowlist and next smallest step.
```
